description: Runs once after the first input values are set. The place to start work that depends on inputs.
Runs before `ngOnInit` and on every input change with a `SimpleChanges` map (`previousValue`, `currentValue`, `firstChange`).
Runs once before the component is destroyed. Clean up timers, listeners and subscriptions.
Injectable handle with `onDestroy(callback)`; lets you register cleanup next to setup, also in services.
Runs a callback once after the next full render. Browser-only (skipped in SSR). Supports `earlyRead`/`write`/`mixedReadWrite`/`read` phases.
Like `afterNextRender` but runs after every render.
`ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError`: state bound in the template changed after Angular checked it, e.g. in `ngAfterViewInit`.
